news.title: Paramount Australia Laces Up For A Big Year Of Football Headlined By The Women's World Cup
news.lede: Network 10 and Paramout+ has the exclusive rights for the FIFA Women’s World Cup in Brazil for 2027. Four years after the CommBank Matildas captivated the nation with its history-making run to the semi-finals on home soil, Australia’s football heroes will once again be chasing World Cup glory. The team’s unforgettable 2023 campaign united the country, shattered viewing records and inspired a new generation of football fans. The 2023 World Cup was broadcasted on Seven.

news.title: France wins its third electric wheelchair football World Cup
news.lede: The French electric wheelchair football team won its third consecutive World Cup, after its coronations in 2017 and 2023. The Blues won a thrilling final against England (2-1 after extra time), in Buenos Aires, Argentina, thanks to goals from Mohamed Ghelami and Tristan Le Beller. Beaten by the English (3-1) when they entered the fray, the French were able to re-mobilize to seek a historic title. With this third world crown, David Vergé’s men become the first nation to achieve such a hat-trick in the discipline.

news.title: FIFA to visit potential 2030 World Cup host cities in November and December
news.lede: A general view shows construction works of the Hassan II Stadium, ahead of the World Cup, in Benslimane, near Casablanca, Morocco, May 23, 2026. Picture taken with a mobile phone. Oct 27 - FIFA will carry out a series of visits to candidate host cities in Spain, Portugal and Morocco in November and December as part of the venue selection process for the 2030 World Cup, world football's governing body said on Tuesday. A FIFA delegation will visit candidate cities and stadiums in all three host countries to assess their suitability to host games.
